external_sources.note: 仅采集域名候选；最终策略由 GPT 基于至少两个独立可信来源审查。上游规则策略、模块、脚本、MITM、DNS、Rewrite 一律不采纳。

release_policy.rule_scope: DOMAIN only; DOMAIN-SUFFIX requires separate explicit manual approval
release_policy.approval_rule: At least 3 of 5 approval criteria must be satisfied; each criterion must be evidence-backed and recorded in the review reason.

approval_criteria.description: At least two independent trustworthy HTTPS sources; syndicated copies of the same source do not count separately
Direct evidence supports the exact hostname's purpose or operator
A defensible policy is clear: DIRECT, PROXY, or REJECT
No material risk of disrupting login, payment, messaging, push, updates, CDN/media delivery, system, or core app functionality

mandatory_vetoes: A confirmed existing-rule conflict or an unresolved first-match outcome blocks APPROVED
A credible unresolved risk of disrupting critical system or core application functionality blocks APPROVED
A candidate with insufficient evidence to identify its purpose or operator cannot be APPROVED solely from its hostname or third-party blocklist inclusion
release_policy.review_status: If fewer than 3 criteria are met, or any mandatory veto applies, status must be REVIEW.
release_policy.publish_gate: APPROVED is a review-buffer status only; publishing remains a separate user-authorized workflow requiring confirm_release=true.
